units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 14:3">Targ. Ps. XIV, 3</cite> (h. text <cite ref="C00993"><he>גם</he></cite>); a. e.—

R. Hash. 25ᵃ (reading אתם Lev. XXIII, 2; 4; 37 as if אַתֶּם) ‘which ye will proclaim’, אתם אפי׳ וכ׳ ye even if erring in the appointment of the festive calendar &c., i.e. the appointment of the Supreme Court is definite and binding.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9a:10">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>א׳ לרבנן</he> even if following the opinion of &c.; a. v. fr. [Cant. R. end <he>א׳ להחריבו</he>, v. next w.]
